info.title: Kafdeck experimental managed-browser API
info.description: G03 contract revision, not a product release. Experimental dashboard integration, browser OIDC session only; not a stable third-party/Bearer/CLI API. Runtime discovery returns only actually mapped operations. Unknown JSON properties are currently ignored; handler preconditions remain authoritative. Missing or malformed JSON, authentication boundaries and infrastructure can reject a request before the handler.

x-compatibility-policy: Source-coupled to the shipped dashboard; review contract changes together with handlers. No independent stable-client or CLI parity guarantee. Existing versioned public contracts are retained.

post.summary: Create or reconcile an ordinary managed user
post.description: Only viewer/operator/manager grants. Requires the admin-only Keycloak provisioning attribute. Unknown outcomes return 409 identity-provisioning-pending with operationId; retain the same request/material or use recovery. At-least-once audit uses stable request correlation. Exact retry does not reset/reuse the submitted password. No Idempotency-Key header.

post.summary: Register or reuse a Kafka target
post.description: SASL requires mechanism, nonblank username/password without controls; non-SASL rejects all three. TLS allows optional CA plus paired client certificate/key, and optional key password; plaintext rejects TLS fields. TLS certificate and hostname verification stay enabled. Registered/new targets must satisfy configured CIDRs for bootstrap and returned broker metadata. Up to four simultaneous probes, five-second Kafka metadata deadline. Snapshot is not a promise of an active credential lease; the existing bounded lease/cache contract still applies. A new registered target returns HTTP 200, not 201, and a stable connection-* ID. Deduplication matches protocol and case-insensitive bootstrap set, not display name or SASL mechanism. Registration limit 256, name collision yields 409. Secrets are retained only in the existing per-session in-memory lease, not target JSON; reconnect after expiry/restart. Audit records actual outcome without broker/name/credential data. No Idempotency-Key header.
post.x-availability: OIDC and ConnectionWorkspace.Enabled and managed owner for registration

put.description: Registered Kafka target only. Compare-and-set revision is checked before provider IO and again under the file lease before save. A stale revision yields 409 without saving. Credentials require HTTPS except for loopback; URLs resolve only onto permitted networks and redirects remain disabled. Basic requires nonempty username without colon/controls and secret; bearer secret has no whitespace or non-ASCII characters. Empty/omitted credentials can retain the prior protected value only for unchanged normalized URL/auth. Changing URL/auth requires credentials again; none clears the credential. Provider probes use an eight-second operation deadline and four shared slots. Success returns only the public normalized URL, authentication mode and new opaque revision. Do not blindly repeat after a lost save response; reload revision first.

BrowserSession.name: Kafdeck.Session
BrowserSession.description: Established through the configured Keycloak/OIDC browser flow; managed routes reject NonBrowserReadIdentity.

Antiforgery.name: X-Kafdeck-CSRF
Antiforgery.description: Use token from GET /api/v1/auth/csrf (setup also returns csrf) with matching HttpOnly Kafdeck.Antiforgery cookie; reacquire after principal changes.

code.description: 32 hexadecimal characters; whitespace trimmed. One-use host-issued code, normally expires after 15 minutes.

email.description: Trimmed, lowercased exact mailbox address; no controls.

csrf.description: Request token only while available; not the setup code.

clusterIds.description: All IDs must currently exist; duplicates are collapsed and IDs sorted. Empty grants no cluster access.

requestId.description: Optional nonempty GUID. Reuse the same ID and access material to reconcile; password is not replayed/reset.

clusterIds.description: All IDs must currently exist; duplicates are collapsed and IDs sorted. Empty grants no cluster access.
All IDs must currently exist; duplicates are collapsed and IDs sorted. Empty grants no cluster access.

bootstrapServers.description: Also rejects case-insensitive duplicates. New/registered targets require canonical IP:port entries in an allowed CIDR; configured targets may use their configured names.

name.description: Trimmed, nonempty name required for a new target. Controls, bidi overrides/isolates and supplied credential substrings are rejected.

url.description: HTTP(S) absolute URL, no userinfo/query/fragment/backslash/controls; resolved service IPs must pass allowed-network checks.

secret.description: Omitted/empty with omitted/empty username retains a protected credential only for unchanged normalized URL and auth type. New credentials otherwise required.

revision.description: Expected revision; null/omitted only for an unconfigured service.

topic.description: A single dot or double dot is rejected.

fields.description: Unique names case-insensitively, including the primary key.
